summary: Keeps array types whose component type is raw (instead of dropping them as raw) when computing tree types, so nullness of array elements is still checked; the diff also carries a stacked fix resolving unbound generic method references against the functional-interface receiver.

tests.evidence: Behavior change in every getTreeType caller; tests were added for parameter, for-each, ternary, raw-to-parameterized and inference contexts (commits e5d438ef4f, c828135274 note an earlier test passed with the fix reverted), but the raw-array-as-target direction CodeRabbit raised (@Nullable Test<String>[] into Test[]) still has no test.

doc_comments.evidence: Public resolveMemberReference and record ResolvedMethodReference added, getMemberReferenceMethodType gains a parameter, getTreeType @return contract changed; comments were corrected in 7d397c8db4 and db52657725 (helper renamed to typeOrNullIfRawNonArray). Minor typo 'javac compute' remains.

change_description.evidence: Description covers only raw arrays; it omits the new diagnostics now reported (incompatible types for @Nullable Test[] -> Test<String>[], per commit e5d438ef4f) and the bundled method-reference changes (issue1795 tests).

backward_compat.evidence: Users in JSpecify mode may see new errors on code NullAway was silent on; expected for a checker improvement.

error_model.evidence: New diagnostics surface with messages like 'Test<String> []' (space before brackets), produced by existing pretty-printing.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial change to getTreeType and method-ref resolution; CodeRabbit's unresolved finding: raw-array targets still exit early via isRaw() guards (GenericsChecks ~2122, 2039, 2496, 3543) so assigning @Nullable Test<String>[] to Test[] is not checked, inconsistent with the new policy.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Reports diagnostics that were previously suppressed for raw-component arrays (commit e5d438ef4f), which users will notice after upgrading.

contradictions.evidence: Comments and helper name were aligned with the code by db52657725/7d397c8db4; residual asymmetry between raw-array source and raw-array target handling is covered under correctness.

spec_conformance.evidence: Interprets javac/JLS raw-type semantics for arrays and JSpecify nullness of array components and method-reference typing.

plan.why: Large type-system change bundled with a stacked method-ref fix: one agent for logic/spec/tests, one for comments, description and user-visible diagnostics.
